parameters.help_en: The invitation ID, obtained from the InviteSbuAccount operation
parameters.name: invite_id

Code.description_en:
The result code.
Error code. Valid values:
200: OK.
1109: System error.
3058: Emails are sent too frequently. A maximum of 10 emails can be sent within 5 minutes.
3057: InviteId is empty.
3060: No sending record found for the specified InviteId.
3061: The registration URL has expired and the email cannot be resent

3058: 发送过于频繁，限定5分钟10封邮件 3057: InviteId 为空
3060: 找不到InviteId的发送记录
3061: 注册URL过期，无法重发
